purpose: C2 low-frequency account context, instrument reference and delayed/indicative price observation
credential_input: in-memory function argument supplied by the approved OAuth owner
sequence: validate accepted operational-gate and approved provider-decision documents before client construction
validate token expiry and create bounded SIM-only client
GET accounts and balances; emit only HMAC account fingerprint and non-sensitive currency metadata
GET 11 instrument details and validate canonical UIC/AssetType/symbol/currency/tradability/quantity rules
GET all 11 InfoPrices in one response and validate exact UIC set, available reference price integrity, age, delay and observation span; real-time and two-sided Bid/Ask are not required
build schema-validated redacted receipts in memory
close session and release token/client references
register receipts only in a separate explicitly invoked append-only step
